config.model: Var(A-B) = SE_A^2 + SE_B^2 - 2 rho SE_A SE_B
config.why: two methods in one results table are evaluated on the same benchmark instances, so their errors are positively correlated and the difference is paired
config.direction_of_the_error: assuming rho=0 inflates the standard error of the difference and therefore inflates this paper failure rate, which is the direction an author auditing other people statistics has least right to err in
config.limitation: papers do not print the covariance, so this is a sensitivity analysis and not an estimate

notes: The headline 40.9 percent assumes independence. At a plausible rho of 0.5 it is 34.0 percent, and even at rho 0.9 it is 23.1 percent, so the finding survives the assumption most generous to the field.
